question: In what manner has the purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels been revealed?
premises: The subject is the examination of the triad of jewels.
Its purpose or meaning is the object of revelation.
The revelation is done in a concise manner.
inference: Therefore, the purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels has been revealed briefly.
plain_english: The purpose of the examination of the triad of jewels has been revealed in brief.
